LanguageData.Dominion_Council_LastsDays: It would hold for {0} days, with {1} days' grace to comply.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_YourRecord: You have {0} breach(es) on record: your next would bring {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_NeedsIRBM: Missiles are not in this world (needs InterRim Ballistic Missile).
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_NoCrime: The council has nothing to try them for: no war of aggression, no crimes in the past 90 days and no breaches.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_NothingOccupied: The first faction holds no settlements taken from the second.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_CannotAdmit: Only a faction the world simulation follows, and not outlaws, can be admitted.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_NotAMember: Not a member of the council.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_NotRepeatOffender: Only a member with two or more breaches on record can be expelled.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_CannotHost: They cannot host: not a member, no capital, or (for you) no leadership desk.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_AlreadyHost: They are hosting this session already.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_NoCrisis: They are not in a crisis that needs aid.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_NoDebts: They pay no tribute to anyone.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_NonProliferation: you may not launch missiles while it holds; a strike is a breach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_ArmsEmbargo: you must embargo {0} and send it no troops.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Peacekeeping: you are asked to pay {0} silver toward the force.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Peacekeeping_Aggressor: you must make peace with {0} within the grace period, or be in breach while forces march against you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Tribunal_You: you would be fined {0} silver; refusing is a breach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Recognise_You: you lose your occupied settlements to {0} for good.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Recognise_Holder: the settlements you occupy become yours for good.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Liberation_You: you must hand {0}'s settlements back within {1} days, or be in breach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Expel_You: you would lose your seat and vote for {0} days.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Host_You: you would host the next session at your capital.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_ReliefFund: you are asked for {0} silver for {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_FreeTrade: you may not embargo another member (except under sanctions).
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_DebtRelief_You: the tribute you pay is forgiven.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_DebtRelief_Creditor: you must forgive the tribute {0} pays you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Quarantine: you must close your borders to {0}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Refugees: you are asked for {0} silver each time a member's people flee, and must not close your borders to them.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Raiding: ambushing convoys or looting settlements becomes a breach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Duty_Culture: you may not close your borders to another member.
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_NonProliferation_Duty: The Rim Council has banned ballistic missiles. While the decree holds, any missile you launch is a breach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_ArmsEmbargo_Duty: The Rim Council has put an arms embargo on {0}. Embargo it within {1} days and send it no troops, or be in breach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_Peacekeeping_Ask: The Rim Council is sending a peacekeeping force to defend {0} against {1}. Members are asked to pay {2} silver toward it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_Peacekeeping_YouAggresso: The Rim Council has sent a peacekeeping force to defend {0} against you. Make peace within the grace period, or be in breach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_Tribunal_Ask: The Rim Council's tribunal has found against you. Pay a fine of {0} silver to those you wronged?
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_Liberation_Ask: The Rim Council demands that you return these settlements to {0}: {1}. Hand them back?
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_Expelled_You: The Rim Council has suspended your membership for {0} days. You have no seat and no vote, and its decrees no longer protect you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_ReliefFund_Ask: The Rim Council has set up a relief fund for {0}. Your share is {1} silver. Pay it?
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_DebtRelief_Ask: The Rim Council has forgiven {0}'s tribute. Forgive what it owes you?
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_Quarantine_Ask: The Rim Council has quarantined {0} against plague. Close your borders to it?
LanguageData.Dominion_Decree_Refugees_Ask: {0}'s people are fleeing. Under the refugee protection decree, members are asked for {1} silver to help them. Pay it?
LanguageData.Dominion_Penalty_Text_Warning: You have broken the decree "{0}". The council warns you: each further breach will be punished more harshly (a fine, then sanctions, then expulsion).
LanguageData.Dominion_Penalty_Text_Fine: You have broken the decree "{0}" again. The council has fined you: {1} silver was taken from your stores.
LanguageData.Dominion_Penalty_Text_Sanctions: You have broken the decree "{0}" once too often. The council has put sanctions on you: every member must embargo you for 30 days.
LanguageData.Dominion_Penalty_Text_Expulsion: You have broken the council's decrees too often ("{0}" was the last). You are suspended for 60 days: no seat, no vote, no protection.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ledger_Penalty: A penalty decree the council imposed for repeated breaches.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ledger_Click: Click to open its compliance ledger: who complied, who broke it and the penalties.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ledger_Escalation: Penalties grow with each breach on a member's record: a warning, then a fine, then sanctions, then expulsion. Old breaches are forgiven by half each time a decree runs out.
LanguageData.Dominion_Record_Button_Desc: Every past session: each motion, how every member voted, what carried, and how the decrees turned out.
LanguageData.Dominion_Record_None: No session has been held yet.
LanguageData.Dominion_Record_OutcomeKept: Ran its course with no breach; {0} member(s) acted on it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Bloc_None: No blocs: the members are too divided to vote together.
LanguageData.Dominion_Bloc_Desc: Members close in ideology, alliances and goodwill vote together: each leans toward motions sponsored by a fellow member of its bloc. Members: {0}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Chamber_LegendBlocs: Seats grouped and coloured by bloc. Pick a banner to see how members lean.
LanguageData.Dominion_Chamber_SeatMode_Desc: Colour the seats by each member's own colour or by voting bloc, when no banner is picked.
LanguageData.Dominion_Favour_Repaid: You repaid the favour you owed {0}: you backed "{1}".
LanguageData.Dominion_Favour_Ignored: {0} called in the favour you owed them, and you did not back "{1}". They will remember.
LanguageData.Dominion_Favour_Desc: Favours are earned by backing a member's motion that carries, and owed when a member votes your way because you asked. A favour owed to you can be called in at a session to swing that member's vote. A favour you owe is called in when that member next sponsors a motion: back it, or lose goodwill. Favours lapse after {0} days; one you never repaid leaves a grievance.
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_LobbyCallIn: Call in a favour (certain, a strong push)
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_LobbyAskFavour: Ask as a favour ({0} chance; you will owe them one)
LanguageData.Dominion_Council_FavourCalledIn: {0} honours the favour they owed you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Chamber_DisbandedSub: The chamber stands empty. No session will ever be called again; its decrees bind no one.
LanguageData.Dominion_Chamber_DisbandedPropose: The council has been disbanded for good.
